title: Good Gift Idea, Not worth the money
text: Great packaging and a great gifting idea, but the snack that it comes in are a joke. You can buy most if not all these candy at a local Asian market. If you live on the east coast or west coast, this would not be a problem. Let me warn you that the 20-25 piece of candy is extremely misleading. A tiny single wrap chocolate counts as one of those "piece" of candy. You are really getting 10-15 pieces of regular size Japanese candy and for Japanese candy, regular size is small, and small is one piece. If your looking for value, look else were, but if your looking to gift for around $20, this may be just about right.
label: negative
